description:
Same AI. Way better answers. Improve any AI prompt with one hotkey, from any app.

Wysely is a desktop companion that makes the AI you already use give you
noticeably better answers. Press one hotkey anywhere you type — a browser
chat, a desktop AI app, an editor — and Wysely reads your draft prompt,
points out what is missing, and can rewrite it for you before you send it.

Instant on-device analysis is free and unmetered, and works offline: it
never sends your draft anywhere. Optional AI rewrites run server-side on a
weekly allowance. There is also a personal prompt library with reusable
presets, and short plain-English tips that teach you why a prompt worked so
you gradually need the help less.
